title: New Relic License key: one-property twin (length)
summary: 6 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 39 vs provider-documented 40-character hexadecimal string and length: 39 vs the provider-documented 40 characters (docs.newrelic.com: "New Relic ingest license key (40 chars, suffix NRAL)"). Twin of "New Relic License key: must be flagged (provider-documented)" and "New Relic License key: must be flagged (project-policy)".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
